aboutGame.title: What is Build A Boat For Treasure?
paragraphs: Build A Boat For Treasure is a long-running Roblox sandbox from Chillz Studios. You snap blocks together on a build pad, launch your creation into a hazard-filled river, and sail it toward the treasure chest at the end of each stage. Gold collected during a run is credited even if the boat is destroyed, so every attempt moves your progress forward.

Progression comes from better blocks, smarter hulls, and cleaner routes rather than codes. With 200+ blocks, dozens of stages, and community designs ranging from simple rafts to flying machines, Build A Boat For Treasure rewards players who improve one build at a time and learn from every wipe.

modules.name: Build A Boat For Treasure Codes
modules.description: This module covers how redeem codes really work in Build A Boat For Treasure, what rewards players can claim, and where free gold and special parts actually come from.

highlights.label: No Codes
highlights.detail: No verified redeem box exists in Build A Boat For Treasure, so free-gold code lists are not backed by an official source.

highlights.label: Stage Chests
highlights.detail: Gold is earned by reaching the treasure chest at the end of a run, and it is credited even when the boat is destroyed.

highlights.label: Events
highlights.detail: Limited-time events are the only confirmed source of bonus themed rewards and cosmetic drops.

modules.name: Build A Boat For Treasure Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-focused guide explaining the basic build-and-sail loop, how to build a first boat that floats, and how to reach the early treasure chests.

highlights.detail: Start with a wide, flat, symmetric hull so your first boat resists tipping.
Place the seat near the middle and put a steering wheel beside it for clear forward vision.
Fit two thrusters or a sail for steady push, and keep a spare for redundancy.
Tuck balloons low inside the hull for lift without raising the center of mass.
Launch, test, and fix one problem at a time instead of rebuilding from scratch.
Save a known-good blueprint before every experiment so a failed redesign costs nothing.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Build A Boat For Treasure.

items.question: What is Build A Boat For Treasure?
items.answer: Build A Boat For Treasure is a free Roblox sandbox from Chillz Studios where you build a boat from blocks, launch it into a hazard-filled river, and sail it to the treasure chest at the end of each stage.

items.question: Is Build A Boat For Treasure free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Build A Boat For Treasure is free on Roblox, and you can reach the early treasure chests without spending anything, since progress comes from gold earned in runs.

items.question: Does Build A Boat For Treasure have codes?
items.answer: Build A Boat For Treasure has no verified in-game code redemption box, so gold comes from stage chests and events rather than from typing promo strings.

items.question: What is the best beginner boat in Build A Boat For Treasure?
items.answer: For Build A Boat For Treasure, start with a wide, low, light raft, two thrusters, a seat with clear forward vision, a steering wheel beside the seat, and balloons tucked low inside the hull.

items.question: How do you earn gold fast in Build A Boat For Treasure?
items.answer: In Build A Boat For Treasure, push one stage further than your previous best, open every stage treasure chest you reach, and avoid spending gold on decorative blocks until your core upgrades are done.
